source: Shape vectors from the 2026-11-17 audit live smoke (voicefox source/src/kw/url.rs:108-117): the web-signed musicInfo endpoint answers code=200 with data.pic as an absolute https albumcover URL for rid 6550104, and code=-1 msg=歌曲不存在 for rid 999999999999. The literal URLs are the day-of baseline only — CDN hosts/paths rotate — so the tests lock the shape (code==200, pic starts with https://), not the literal URL. Empty and missing pic both fall through the same is_http_url filter (audit gap note); the paid-content text in place of a URL is the upstream url_filter vector applied to the pic gate.
